relevance_note: Panel-sequencing cohort of 112 HSP-like patients in which three individually tabulated patients (P9-P11) carry GFAP variants and have AxD: "| P9 | GFAP | c.197G>A | p.R66Q".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON from my readings and asserted every span verbatim against the paper (table row segments copied from the file). Only the three AxD/GFAP patients (P9, P10, P11) are in scope; the other 10 tabulated patients (ABCD1, GALC, CYP27A1) and the rest of the 112-patient cohort get no rows. No relatives of P9-P11 are described. Table 2: the '–' symbol in the Affected Siblings, Cognitive Dysfunction, Ataxia, Epilepsy, Peripheral Neuropathy and Extraneurological Findings columns is not defined in the legend, so those cells are treated as not reported (no exclusions); '+' read as present. Table 1 'ACMG Criteria' column holds classifications (Pathogenic / Likely Pathogenic / VUS), not criteria codes, so it is recorded as pathogenicity and acmg_criteria_as_stated is not reported. SIFT/MutationTaster/PolyPhen2 are in-silico predictions, not functional assays, so functional_evidence_statement is not reported. Zygosity only for P9 (case text 'heterozygous'); not stated for P10/P11. No parental/segregation testing reported for any AxD patient. 'Spastic paraplegia was the main finding in all patients' used as a named-group statement (observed) for P10 and P11; abstract 'None of the patients had evidence of diffuse leukodystrophy on neuroimaging' used as a named-group exclusion of diffuse leukodystrophy only (does not exclude the broader cerebral white matter checklist item; P10 has 'Mild WML'). Inclusion criterion (3) not used. Discussion 'Neither case in our series had palatal myoclonus or prominent ataxia' does not say which AxD patients it covers ('neither' implies two, but there are three AxD patients) and is not used; palatal tremor stays not reported. It may conflict with Table 2 'Ataxia +' for P11 (qualified as 'prominent'), so P11 ataxia is kept observed and flagged here. P11's GFAP variant is classified VUS in Table 1 although the Results call all 13 'pathogenic mutations'; pathogenicity recorded as VUS from the patient's own row. P9 Table 2 'CST' (cortico-spinal tract hyperintensities) location not specified, so the cerebral white matter checklist item is left not reported for P9. Age at onset is the 'AO (Years)' column (onset of spasticity); P9's 64 years is age at presentation in Case 3. Country/ethnicity not stated per patient (only that the study concerns the Chinese population), left not reported. No stacked cells.

span: We performed genetic analysis using a custom-designed gene panel for leukodystrophies in 112 hereditary spastic paraplegia-like patients.
NGS revealed a heterozygous pathogenic mutation of c.197G>A (p.R66Q) in the GFAP gene.
candidate variants were confirmed by Sanger sequencing
Each patient was eventually diagnosed based on the characteristic MRI findings of severe atrophy from the medulla oblongata to the upper cervical cord
Each proband’s variants and the predictions are listed in Table 1.
